unresolvedIssues.issue: Audi Q5 J841 table calls the item Drive Motor A Current but prints a calculated-voltage minus modeled-voltage criterion above 100 V. Article preserves the signed voltage comparison and exposes the unresolved label/quantity mismatch.

Audi Q7 CNRB table labels F4 consumption high, opposite the generic low-consumption title. Audi A8 CPNA comparison uses the generic direction with different adaptation threshold. Article cites both physical pages and does not combine calibrations.
Audi Q7 CNRB table labels F5 consumption low, opposite generic high-consumption title. Audi A8 CPNA supports the generic direction, with comparator/calibration differences explicitly retained.

Audi Q5 table gives EVAP sensor-B pressure boundaries above149kPa or below11kPa without naming gauge/absolute reference. Article retains originalkPa quantities and explicitly avoids conversion or a universal pressure-test specification.

VW engine2021/22 row shows stuck-in-range suspicion from max/min tank-minus-BARO deviation below0.05kPa and references a vent-valve stuck-closed confirmation, but does not explain their full logical relationship. Article distinguishes suspicion from confirmation and is not presented as a complete GX36 algorithm.

Audi CHJA table names the battery energy control module missing-message event but does not resolve generic title’s module-B qualifier. The article states the reporting context and unresolved qualifier.

Audi CHJA table describes implausible received BECM data but does not establish generic module-B qualifier; article preserves received-invalid versus missing-message distinction and exposes qualifier uncertainty.
